            Touch

            Drag anywhere on the left half to move. You aim and attack automatically. Tap a power to cast it, and tap Dash to dodge.

            The fight

            • Every power costs energy, and each universe names it: Cursed Energy, Chakra, Ki, Haki, the Force. It refills over time and with every kill.
            • Gold-bordered powers are ultimates. They cost the most and play a cinematic when they fire.
            • Waves get bigger each round. Every fifth wave brings a boss from that universe.
            • Green crosses restore health. Blue diamonds restore energy.
            • Chain kills quickly to build a combo. It multiplies your score up to ×5.
